The plate is a square side plate, about 22 cm across. It spans roughly 190–530 px, so about 340 px, which gives about 0.065 cm per px.

Roasted potato cubes cover about 200×180 px, roughly 13×12 cm. They are piled about 2 cm high, with perhaps 25 cubes of about 2 cm each. A 2 cm cube is about 8 cm³, or about 8 g × 1.0, so 25 cubes come to about 200 g. Some cubes are smaller, so I estimate 170 g.

Roasted Brussels sprouts cover about 150×200 px, roughly 9×13 cm. There are about 15 sprouts at about 8–12 g each, so about 150 g. Some are small, so I estimate 130 g.

Visible oil is minor and mostly absorbed, so I add about 5 g.
